digest.component_or_area: Rebar Janitor remediation and verification system
propositions: Contributor and agent guidance must use each contributor's configured real DCO identity instead of automated bot identity except where explicitly required by automated workflows.
The force flag bypasses all gates including future gates, while ticket-system invariants such as the open-children close prohibition remain non-bypassable.
LLM verification must maintain flexible provider-independent parsing and self-healing without accepting semantically empty results as valid review outcomes.
Plan review cannot produce a clean pass when ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless the omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant.
Safe ChatGPT workflows must be documented for connector-limited environments where GitHub repository is read-only, native clone and Gerrit access are unavailable.
